desc: positive: Force multiq to dequeue from its child's gso_skb with dualpi2 leaf
pre: ip link set dev eth0 addrgenmode none || true
ip link set dev eth0 up || true
ip l set addr 01:02:03:04:05:06 dev eth0 || true
ip n add dev eth0 10.10.11.1 lladdr 01:02:03:04:05:06 dev eth0 || true
ip addr add 10.10.11.10/24 dev eth0 || true
tc qdisc add dev eth0 root handle 1: tbf rate 88bit burst 1661b peakrate 2257333 minburst 1024 limit 7b
tc qdisc add dev eth0 parent 1: handle 2: multiq
tc qdisc add dev eth0 parent 2:1 handle 3: dualpi2
tc filter add dev eth0 parent 2: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match ip dst 10.10.11.1 action skbedit queue_mapping 0
tc filter add dev eth0 parent 3: protocol ip prio 1 u32 match ip dst 10.10.11.1 classid 3:1 action ok

readback.cmd: tc -j -s qdisc ls dev eth0 handle 3:
readback.name: verify
